header.title: Opportunities picked for you
header.lede: Ranked by how well each one fits your profile and goals. Tap Apply for me and we prepare the rest.
header.label: Your scout
header.newThisWeek: {count, plural, =0 {No new picks this week yet} one {# new pick this week} other {# new picks this week}}
header.scoringLocal: matched by rules from your profile
header.scoringAi: ranked with AI from your profile
header.noGoals: Set a goal so your scout knows what to look for.

profileHint.emptyTitle: Your scout is working from very little
profileHint.emptyBody: Drop in your résumé, deck or portfolio and these picks get much sharper. It takes a minute and no typing.
profileHint.draftTitle: Confirm your profile for sharper picks
profileHint.draftBody: Your scout is using a draft. A quick check of your profile tells it exactly who you are.

search.label: Search opportunities
search.placeholder: Search by name, organisation or topic
search.everything: Searching everything open, not only your picks.

region.title: Country
region.hint: Countries on your picks. Ones open worldwide always show.
region.empty: Countries appear here once your scout has picks.

effort.title: Your time
effort.hint: Minutes you spend. We prepare everything else.

empty.lookingBody: It’s reading open opportunities against your profile and goals. This usually takes under a minute.
empty.idleBody: Tap Look again and your scout compares every open opportunity with your profile and goals.
empty.filteredBody: Loosen a filter or clear them all. Your other picks are still waiting.
empty.searchBody: Try fewer or different words, or clear the search.
empty.laterBody: Tap Later on any pick and it waits here until you’re ready.
empty.allBody: New ones arrive every day, and your scout brings the good ones to your picks.
empty.seenAllBody: Your scout looks again as new opportunities arrive. You can also send it out now.

refresh.failed: Your scout couldn’t finish looking. Try again in a minute.

feedback.learns: Your scout will show you fewer like it.
feedback.whyHint: One tap. It teaches your scout.

deadline.days: {days, plural, one {Closes tomorrow} other {Closes in # days}}
deadline.unknown: Deadline not listed: check the official page

do.confirmHandoff: Just confirm, plus a quick sign-in on their site
do.handoff: Quick handoff: you submit on their site
do.documents: We draft it, you use it

import.title: Add an opportunity you found
import.description: Paste the link to a job, call, program or competition. We read the page and put it at the top of your board.
import.label: Link
import.hint: The organiser’s own page works best.
import.invalid: That doesn’t look like a link. Paste the full address, starting with https://.
import.privacy: Only you see links you add. We read the page once and keep a copy to spot changes later.
import.added: Added to the top of your board
import.alreadyThere: Already on Onward Scout, now pinned to your board
import.typeGuessed: The page didn’t say what kind of opportunity it is, so we filed it under your goal. Check the details on the official page.
import.missing: Some details weren’t on the page. They show as “check the official page”.

detail.minutes: {minutes, plural, one {About # minute of your time} other {About # minutes of your time}}
detail.noOfficial: The organiser’s link isn’t known yet.
detail.unknownNote: Anything we couldn’t confirm says “check the official page”. We never fill gaps with guesses.

practice.title: What this practice run shows you
practice.one: See exactly what Onward Scout prepares and submits, start to finish
practice.two: Goes to our own sandbox form — nothing reaches a real organisation
practice.three: Free: practice runs never use credits

why.title: Why it fits you
why.local: Matched by comparing your profile with this opportunity’s details. Rules, not guesses.
why.ai: Ranked with AI from your profile and the organiser’s page. Every reason traces back to one of them.

about.title: About this opportunity
about.none: The organiser’s page has the full details.

required.title: What it asks for
required.none: The organiser doesn’t list materials. We read their form when you apply.

by.platform: We draft it from your profile
by.either: We use yours, or draft it from your profile

how.title: How Onward Scout applies
how.mine: You added this link. We read it automatically and haven’t reviewed it, so check the details on the official page.
how.email: Sent from your own Gmail, written for this recipient, and only after you approve it.
how.documents: We draft the documents from your sourced facts; you use them where they’re needed.
how.login: Their site asks you to sign in, so the last step is a short handoff: you log in, and everything else is ready.
how.captcha: If their form shows a CAPTCHA, you solve it. We never get around them.
how.fee: There’s an application fee. You pay it yourself on their site.
how.practice: This goes to Onward Scout’s own sandbox form. Nothing reaches a real organisation and no credits are used.
how.tap: Nothing is submitted until you tap.

eligibility.none: The organiser lists no eligibility rules here. Check the official page before you apply.

experienceMax.unknown: Meant for people with up to {years} years of experience. Check how yours counts.
